provenance.sla_p99_s: Scenario target for interactive responses; varied in sensitivity analysis (1.2-2.0 s).
provenance.t1_short_s,t1_long_s,serial_frac: Scenario assumption for CPU inference of a sub-1B model; varied in sensitivity analysis.
provenance.mb_per_vcpu,max_vcpu: AWS Lambda documentation (memory-proportional CPU, 1,769 MB = 1 vCPU, max 6 vCPU).
provenance.runtime_init_s: Measured: median INIT duration 101 ms in 61 AWS Lambda REPORT lines (this study).
provenance.model_gb_*,load_gbps_*: Scenario assumption; model artefact size and load bandwidth.
provenance.pc_delay: Scenario assumption; PC allocation is asynchronous; varied 0-2.
provenance.keepalive_tau_min: Scenario assumption consistent with reported idle keep-alive of minutes; varied 3-15.
provenance.price_*: AWS Lambda pricing page, us-east-1 x86 (on-demand duration, requests, PC).
